statement: A top-5 developer reports AI systems did >= 50% of code or experiments in a frontier training project (technical report or system card; by 2028-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met on the formal criterion; the informal signal was strong. Leaders of one top-5 Bloc A developer said in talks and podcasts that AI wrote ~80-90% of code for its coding tool (May) and for 'most teams' (Oct). Another top-5 firm said >30% of its new code was AI-generated (Apr). None of these claims appeared in a technical report or system card about a frontier training project. The developer's own Dec study found staff used AI in ~59% of their work but could 'fully delegate' only 0-20%.

items.summary: The CEO of a top-5 Bloc A developer predicted that within 3-6 months AI would write 90% of code, and within 12 months essentially all of it.
items.detail: Dario Amodei (Anthropic), Council on Foreign Relations event, March 2025; reported by Business Insider; recapped by ITPro 2025-09-15. Exact event date approximate.

items.summary: The CEO of a top-5 Bloc A developer's parent said on an earnings call that more than 30% of the company's new code was AI-generated, up from ~25% in October 2024. The figure covers company-wide code, not a frontier training project.
items.detail: Sundar Pichai, Alphabet Q1 2025 earnings call (2025-04-24). Microsoft's CEO separately said ~20-30% of code in some repos was AI-written (LlamaCon, 2025-04-29).

items.summary: A lead engineer at a top-5 Bloc A developer said roughly 80% (maybe 80-90%) of the code of its agentic coding tool was written by the tool itself, with human review. The claim was informal (podcast) and about a product, not a training project.
items.detail: Boris Cherny (Anthropic), Latent Space podcast; reported by OfficeChai 2025-05-12.

items.summary: The same developer's CEO said its AI now writes 90% of code for most teams at the company, while humans remain essential for editing, the hardest parts and supervision. This was a conference remark, not a technical report.
items.detail: Dario Amodei at Salesforce Dreamforce (2025-10-15); Business Insider 2025-10-16.

items.summary: The developer's internal study (132 staff surveyed in Aug 2025, 200k coding-agent transcripts) found staff used AI in ~59% of their work (up from 28% a year earlier) with a self-reported ~50% productivity gain, but most could 'fully delegate' only 0-20%. Agents chained ~21 actions without human input, up from ~10. It gave no share of frontier-training code or experiments.
items.detail: Anthropic, 'How AI is transforming work at Anthropic' (2025-12-02).

items.summary: No 2025 technical report or system card from a top-5 developer quantified the AI share of code or experiments in a frontier training project. Public figures were executive remarks or product-codebase anecdotes, so the indicator could not be measured from qualifying sources.
items.detail: Checked: Anthropic (Claude 4, Opus 4.5 system cards), OpenAI GPT-5 system card, Google Gemini 3 Pro FSF report. Bloc B developers not checked.
